Shotgun metagenomic DNA libraries from soil and rhizosphere (rhizosheath) samples were extracted with the QIAGEN DNeasy PowerSoil Pro kit, prepared with the ONT Native Barcoding Kit 96 V14 (SQK-NBD114.96) using end-prep and ligation, pooled and sequenced on an ONT PromethION, then basecalled and demultiplexed with Dorado v1.1.1 in super-accurate (sup) mode and quality filtered (median Q>=15, length >=300bp).

Oxford Nanopore long-read shotgun metagenome sequencing was performed on DNA extracted (QIAGEN DNeasy PowerSoil Pro) from greenhouse pot microcosm soils under different crop treatments and no-plant controls (25 days), with libraries prepared using ONT Native Barcoding Kit 96 V14 (SQK-NBD114.96), pooled and sequenced on an ONT PromethION (PromethION 2 Solo), then basecalled and demultiplexed with Dorado (SUP).
